mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE TaskTree AS ( SELECT TASK_ID, TASK_NM, PARENT_TASK_ID, TASK_START_DT, TASK_END_DT, TASK_PROGRESS, 1 AS LVL, CAST(LPAD(TASK_ID, 20, '0') AS CHAR(500)) AS SORT_PATH, CAST(TASK_NM AS CHAR(1000)) AS FULL_PATH FROM TASK_MASTER WHERE (PARENT_TASK_ID IS NULL OR PARENT_TASK_ID = 0) AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND (TASK_TYPE_CD = 'CM007CD001' OR TASK_TYPE_CD = 'CM007CD002')
UNION ALL
SELECT t.TASK_ID, t.TASK_NM, t.PARENT_TASK_ID, t.TASK_START_DT, t.TASK_END_DT, t.TASK_PROGRESS, tt.LVL + 1, CONCAT(tt.SORT_PATH, '-', LPAD(t.TASK_ID, 20, '0')), CONCAT(tt.FULL_PATH, ' > ', t.TASK_NM) FROM TASK_MASTER t INNER JOIN TaskTree tt ON t.PARENT_TASK_ID = tt.TASK_ID WHERE t.DEL_YN = 'N' AND t.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} )
SELECT TASK_ID, CONCAT(REPEAT(' ', LVL - 1), '└─ ', TASK_NM) AS VISUAL_HIERARCHY, TASK_NM,
CASE WHEN IFNULL(TRIM(TASK_START_DT), '') = '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CAST(TASK_END_DT AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') ELSE TASK_START_DT END AS TASK_START_DT,
TASK_END_DT, TASK_PROGRESS, LVL, FULL_PATH, PARENT_TASK_ID, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM TaskTree WHERE TASK_END_DT IS NOT NULL AND TASK_END_DT != '' ORDER BY SORT_PATH
LIMIT #{start}, #{length}

SELECT T.DOMAIN_ID , T.COMPANY_CD , T.TASK_ID , T.TASK_NM , T.TASK_DETAIL , T.TASK_STATE_CD , T.TASK_START_DT , T.TASK_END_DT , T.TASK_IMPORTANCE_CD , T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID , SF_GET_MEMBER_NAME(T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID) AS TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_NM , T.REPORT_MEMBER_ID , SF_GET_MEMBER_NAME(T.REPORT_MEMBER_ID) AS REPORT_MEMBER_NM , T.TASK_PROGRESS , T.PARENT_TASK_ID , T.TASK_TYPE_CD , T.PROJECT_ID , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM007', T.TASK_TYPE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_TYPE_NM , TT.TASK_NM AS PARENT_TASK_NM , CONVERT_TZ(T.UPDATE_DT, '+00:00', '+09:00') AS UPDATE_DT , SF_GET_MEMBER_NAME(T.UPDATE_USR) AS UPDATE_USR FROM TASK_MASTER T LEFT JOIN TASK_MASTER TT ON (TT.TASK_ID = T.PARENT_TASK_ID AND TT.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID)
T.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND T.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND (T.DEL_YN = 'N' OR T.DEL_YN IS NULL)

SELECT TE.DOMAIN_ID , TE.COMPANY_CD , TE.TASK_ID , TE.EMAIL , TE.TASK_EMP_CD , E.EMP_NM FROM TASK_EMP TE INNER JOIN TASK_MASTER T ON (TE.TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID AND TE.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID) INNER JOIN EMP_MASTER E ON (E.EMAIL = TE.EMAIL AND E.DOMAIN_ID = TE.DOMAIN_ID AND E.COMPANY_CD = TE.COMPANY_CD)
TE.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND TE.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND TE.EMAIL != T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TASK_MASTER
DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND PARENT_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND (DEL_YN = 'N' OR DEL_YN IS NULL)

SELECT T.DOMAIN_ID , T.COMPANY_CD , T.TASK_ID , T.TASK_NM , T.TASK_DETAIL , T.TASK_STATE_CD , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM001', T.TASK_STATE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_STATE , T.TASK_START_DT , T.TASK_END_DT , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM002', T.TASK_IMPORTANCE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_IMPORTANCE , T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID , SF_GET_MEMBER_NAME(T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID) AS TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_NM , T.TASK_PROGRESS , T.TASK_TYPE_CD , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM007', T.TASK_TYPE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_TYPE_NM , T.PARENT_TASK_ID , T.PROJECT_ID FROM TASK_MASTER T
T.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND T.COMPANY_CD = #{companyCd} AND PARENT_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND (T.DEL_YN = 'N' OR T.DEL_YN IS NULL)
ORDER BY TASK_STATE, T.TASK_END_DT, T.TASK_IMPORTANCE_CD

SELECT DISTINCT T.DOMAIN_ID , T.COMPANY_CD , T.TASK_ID , T.TASK_NM , T.TASK_DETAIL , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM001', T.TASK_STATE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_STATE , T.TASK_START_DT , T.TASK_END_DT , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM002', T.TASK_IMPORTANCE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_IMPORTANCE , T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID , T.TASK_PROGRESS , T.CHILD_TASK_ADD_YN , C.COMPANY_NM EMP_COMPANY_NM , E.EMP_NM , TE.TASK_EMP_CD , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM004', TE.TASK_EMP_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_EMP , TT.TASK_NM AS PARENT_TASK_NM , T.PARENT_TASK_ID , 'Y' AS CHILD_YN FROM TASK_MASTER T INNER JOIN TASK_EMP TE ON (TE.TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID AND TE.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID) LEFT JOIN EMP_MASTER E ON (E.EMAIL = T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID AND E.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID AND E.COMPANY_CD = T.COMPANY_CD) INNER JOIN COMPANY_MASTER C ON (C.DOMAIN_ID = E.DOMAIN_ID AND C.COMPANY_CD = E.COMPANY_CD) LEFT JOIN TASK_MASTER TT ON (TT.TASK_ID = T.PARENT_TASK_ID AND TT.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID AND TT.COMPANY_CD = T.COMPANY_CD) LEFT JOIN TASK_LABEL TL ON (TL.TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID AND TL.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID)
T.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND T.CHILD_TASK_ADD_YN = 'N' AND T.PARENT_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND (T.DEL_YN = 'N' OR T.DEL_YN IS NULL)
GROUP BY T.TASK_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN T.TASK_END_DT is NULL THEN '2' WHEN T.TASK_END_DT = '' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END, T.TASK_END_DT, T.TASK_IMPORTANCE_CD, COALESCE(T.PARENT_TASK_ID, T.TASK_ID), T.PARENT_TASK_ID IS NOT NULL, T.TASK_ID

SELECT N.DOMAIN_NAME , N.COMPANY , N.NAVER_DOMAIN_ID , N.SERVICE_ACCOUNT , N.CLIENT_ID , N.CLIENT_SECRET , N.PRIVATE_KEY , N.USE_YN FROM NAVER_IF_CONFIG N WHERE N.DOMAIN_NAME = #{domainId} AND N.COMPANY = #{companyCd} AND N.USE_YN = 'Y'
